rules.statement: A surety who has undertaken liability as co-principal debtor has impliedly and tacitly renounced their right to plead the defence of beneficium ordinis seu excussionis.
rules.supporting_quote: I am therefore of the view that by undertaking liability as co-principal debtor, the Defendants have impliedly as well as tacitly renounced their right to plead the defence of beneficium ordinis seu excussionis.
